mapper.sql: kg_classroom.id id, kg_classroom.kg_id `kgId`, kg_classroom.class_name `className` , kg_classroom.grade_id `gradeId` , kg_classroom.teacher_id `teacherId` , kg_classroom.sub_teacher_id `subTeacherId` , kg_kindergarten_staff.name `teacherName`, kg_grade.grade_name `gradeName`

select
from kg_classroom left join kg_kindergarten_staff on kg_classroom.teacher_id = kg_kindergarten_staff.id left join kg_grade on kg_classroom.grade_id = kg_grade.id where kg_classroom.del_flag = 0
mapper.select: SELECT kc.id, kc.class_name, kc.grade_id, kg.grade_name, kks.id `teacher_id`, kks.NAME `teacher_name`, kks2.id `sub_teacher_id`, kks2.NAME `sub_teacher_name` FROM kg_classroom kc LEFT JOIN kg_grade kg ON kc.grade_id = kg.id LEFT JOIN kg_kindergarten_staff kks ON kc.teacher_id = kks.id LEFT JOIN kg_kindergarten_staff kks2 ON kc.sub_teacher_id = kks2.id WHERE kc.kg_id = #{queryVO.kgId} AND kc.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY kc.create_time DESC

select kc.id `id`, kc.kg_id `kgId`, class_name `className`, grade_id `gradeId`, teacher_id `teacherId`, sub_teacher_id `subTeacherId`, kg.grade_name `gradeName` from kg_classroom kc left join kg_grade kg on kc.grade_id = kg.id where kc.del_flag = 0 and kc.kg_id = #{kgId}

SELECT kc.id, kc.class_name, kc.student_count, kks.`name` teacherName FROM kg_classroom kc LEFT JOIN kg_kindergarten_staff kks ON kc.teacher_id = kks.id WHERE kc.kg_id = #{kgId} AND kc.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY kc.create_time DESC

SELECT kc.id, kc.class_name, kc.student_count, kks.`name` teacherName FROM kg_classroom kc LEFT JOIN kg_kindergarten_staff kks ON kc.teacher_id = kks.id WHERE kc.del_flag = FALSE AND kc.kg_id = #{kgId} AND kc.student_count > 0 ORDER BY kc.create_time DESC
SELECT kc.id, kc.class_name, kc.student_count, kks.`name` teacherName FROM kg_classroom kc LEFT JOIN kg_kindergarten_staff kks ON kc.teacher_id = kks.id WHERE kc.id = #{classId}
